items.title: Nagata compactification for algebraic spaces: a separated finite type map admits a proper surjective modification with proper representable closure
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space Y over a scheme S and a separated finite type morphism f : X -> Y, the lemma builds a diagram X <- X' -> closure(X)' -> Y with X' -> X proper surjective, X' an open subspace of closure(X)', and closure(X)' -> Y proper and representable. The retained proof is written in two reduction stages: first a closed immersion of X into a space X_1 separated of finite presentation over Y (Limits of Spaces, proposition-separated-closed-in-finite-presentation) reduces to finite presentation; then absolute Noetherian approximation writes Y as a directed limit of finite type Z-spaces, descends X_i -> Y_i of finite presentation with the separated property (Limits of Spaces, lemmas descend-finite-presentation and descend-separated-morphism), and applies the Noetherian case of the chapter (lemma-chow-noetherian). Retained author proof at lines 9400-9429.
